title: Kontoor Brands Board of Directors Elects Jamie Caulfield, Former PepsiCo, Inc. Chief Financial Officer and Michael Skipworth, President and Chief Executive Officer of Wingstop Inc. as New Directors
summary: GREENSBORO, N.C., September 23, 2026--Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB) (the "Company" or "Kontoor"), today announced that Jamie Caulfield and Michael Skipworth have been elected to the Company’s board of directors effective immediately.
